prospective_changes: row overcoverage is diagnostic rather than invalid for group-max intervals
interval efficiency replaces the row-coverage upper gate
physics-informed feature GP and larger budgets address OOD mean error

partition.domain_disclosure: fresh exact coordinates in the same declared L0 domain; coarse spatial overlap is intentional

features.physics_rationale: known L0 thrust scales with flow, sqrt(voltage), utilization, charge and divergence; Isp scales primarily with sqrt(voltage), charge and divergence

model_selection.training_selection: first budget rows of the frozen scrambled candidate sequence
model_selection.family_tie_break: within the smallest passing budget, lowest method-group OOD worst error, then overall NRMSE, then family name
model_selection.selection: smallest budget with point, group-stability and interval-efficiency gates passing on method labels only

conformal.implementation: inherited exact v7 group-max rank semantics
conformal.target: simultaneous coverage of every row in a future exchangeable group

gates.width_rationale: typical full uncertainty band must consume no more than one quarter of fixed engineering output range and 90th-percentile band no more than two fifths; thresholds are engineering-scale limits, not v7 empirical quantiles
gates.row_coverage_upper: diagnostic-only because simultaneous group-max validity intentionally overcovers individual rows
gates.acceptance: all point, row-lower, simultaneous-group, stability, median-width and p90-width gates pass in every stratum and overall

identity.execution: clean detached exact preregistration commit with explicit worktree PYTHONPATH
identity.runtime_closure: actual imported repository module paths and Git blob IDs

claims.allowed: same-domain prospective deterministic L0 software-emulation validation
claims.forbidden: physical accuracy, higher-fidelity accuracy, or untouched coarse spatial regions
